title: refactor(sdk): make convenience helpers single-request
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Makes `generateImage`, `generateVideo`, `generateText`, `chat`, and `generateAudio` issue exactly one upstream request and return one result.
- Removes SDK-owned `n` batching and automatic `seed: -1`; explicit caller seeds still pass through unchanged.
- Keeps `imageGenerate({ n })`, where Gen handles multiple images in one OpenAI-compatible request.
- Updates helper types, examples, and request-count regression tests.

Tests: SDK test suite (32 tests), typecheck, and production build.

gist.headline: One call, one flower
gist.blurb: The SDK convenience helpers have stopped quietly multiplying requests in the garden shed. One helper call now sends one upstream request and brings back one result, exactly as advertised.
gist.summary: Updated the SDK's generateImage, generateVideo, generateText, chat, and generateAudio helpers so each makes exactly one upstream request and returns one result, while imageGenerate({ n }) remains available for OpenAI-compatible multi-image generation.
gist.impact: SDK users get predictable request counts and caller-controlled seeds: automatic seed: -1 and helper-owned n batching are gone, while explicitly supplied seeds continue to pass through unchanged.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy garden workbench represents the SDK helpers becoming literal one-seed, one-flower tools: Polli carefully sends a single glowing request envelope through one tidy tube and receives one finished pixel flower. A nearby retro terminal shows a simple “1 → 1” indicator, while a separate watering can labeled “n” tends a small multi-flower imageGenerate patch to show batching still exists in its dedicated API path.
